meta.instructions: Checks the REAL outcome of a specific StartFileTransfer call -- its initial 200 response only confirms AWS accepted the request, not that the transfer actually completed (this exact blind spot let two failed sends go unnoticed, see dcg-sftp-design.md). To use: run 888-outbound.json or 940-outbound.json, open its 'StartFileTransfer (DCG)' node's output, find the TransferId in the (raw-string, see gotcha #7) response body, then pin data on this workflow's trigger with { "transferId": "<that id>" } (or just paste it directly into the ListFileTransferResults node's jsonBody expression for a one-off check) and execute. Parse Results shows resultCount, allCompleted, and the full per-file results array -- each entry has FilePath, StatusCode ('COMPLETED'/'FAILED'/etc), FailureCode, FailureMessage. AWS keeps results available for up to 7 days after the transfer. After import, re-select the AWS account credential.
